# Vendored AAAI Files

The paper uses the unmodified `aaai2027.sty` and `aaai2027.bst` files from the
official AAAI-27 author kit:

<https://aaai.org/authorkit27/>

The downloaded archive is excluded from Git. Checksums for the two committed
style files are stored in `paper/AAAI27-SHA256SUMS`.

The AAAI-27 paper deadline was July 28, 2026. This repository uses that kit as
the latest available official format and must be checked again against the
author kit for the next open AAAI submission cycle.
